# Coherent nominal basis rows before qmatch

This informed probe for #64 prepares the cycle A to B, B to C, C to A
inside a coherent basis lift, then uses the same owner in a phase-sensitive
qmatch. A classical helper constructs a record in written field order and
projects its declared enum field before another helper matches its value.
The expected physical table is [1,2,0,3]. Only the first three rows are
source rows. The final row completes the physical permutation on padding.

The first observer was a retained earlier CLI with SHA-256
a86863d42184633166b71fee14d5f7df05975f1f080ac041075201c1af40b74f.
The typed proposal initially reached the existing Lean gate and refused
during original dependency discovery. The fixed observation uses the same
original .qli and supplies the original finite labels to the v5 gate.
Timestamps come from captured stdout file write times. Observer executable
paths were reused between builds. The fixed run does not claim full source
preservation.
